Correspondence
Can write letters conveying
degrees of emotion and
highlighting the personal
significance of events.

control
Can produce clearly
intelligible continuous writing
which follows standard layout
and paragraphing
conventions.
Orthographic
control
Spelling and punctuation are
reasonably accurate but may
show signs of mother tongue
influence.
Planning
Can plan what is to be said
and the means to say it,
considering the effect on the
recipient(s).
Sociolinguistic
appropriateness
Can express him / herself
appropriately in situations
and avoid crass errors of
formulation.
